fields.label: Name
fields.variationNote: A variation takes its name from its product and its attributes, so it cannot be changed here.

fields.label: Status
fields.variationNote: A variation can only be published or private.

fields.label: Catalogue visibility
fields.variationNote: Catalogue visibility belongs to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Shown in shop and search
fields.variationNote: Shown in shop and search belongs to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Featured
fields.variationNote: Featured belongs to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Categories
fields.variationNote: Categories belong to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Tags
fields.variationNote: Tags belong to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Regular price
fields.variableParentNote: A variable product takes its price from its variations. Change the variations instead.

fields.label: Sale price
fields.variableParentNote: A variable product takes its price from its variations. Change the variations instead.

fields.label: Stock quantity
fields.variationNote: Stock quantity only applies where stock is managed, so it was not changed here. Turn on Manage stock first.

fields.label: Sold individually
fields.variationNote: Sold individually belongs to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Reviews
fields.variationNote: Reviews belongs to the product, not to each variation.

fields.label: Sample labels
fields.variationNote: “Sample labels” is kept on the product, not on each variation.

actions.description: Takes each product's current value and raises or lowers it by an amount or a percentage. Products with no current value are skipped and counted.

actions.label: Round prices
actions.description: Rounds each price to a number of decimals, to the nearest step, or to a tidy ending such as .95 or .99, going up, down or to the nearest.

field.title: Field
field.description: Choose the field Round prices should change, then try again.

to.title: Round to
to.description: Choose how to round, then try again.

choices.label: The nearest step, such as 5 or 0.50

direction.title: Which way
direction.description: Choose up, down or nearest, then try again.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Enter a whole number of decimals from 0 to 2.

step.title: Step
step.description: Enter the step to round to, as a number above 0 like 5 or 0.50.

ending.title: Ending
ending.description: Enter the ending as the part after the decimal point, like .95 or .99.
